ex.title: A message from Kate
ex.passage:
Hi Sam!
I'm at home in bed with a cold. Can you get me some milk and a lemon? The shop is next to the bus stop.
Thanks! Come at five.
Kate

questions.statement: Kate is at home.

explanation.en: 'I'm at home in bed.'
explanation.he: כתוב: I'm at home in bed – היא בבית, במיטה.

questions.question: What does Kate want?
options: a cup of coffee
milk and a lemon
a bus ticket

0.en: Kate does not ask for coffee. Look at the second sentence.
0.he: קייט לא מבקשת קפה. חזרו למשפט השני.

2.en: The bus stop is only where the shop is.
2.he: תחנת האוטובוס היא רק המקום שבו נמצאת החנות.

explanation.en: 'Can you get me some milk and a lemon?'
explanation.he: קייט מבקשת חלב ולימון: some milk and a lemon.

questions.statement: Kate says: 'Come at nine.'

explanation.en: She says 'Come at five.' five and nine both have i + consonant + silent e, so read them carefully.
explanation.he: היא כותבת Come at five. גם five וגם nine בנויות מ-i + עיצור + e שקטה, אז קראו בעיון.

questions.text: Kate is in ___ with a cold.

explanation.en: 'I'm at home in bed with a cold.' bed has a short e: /e/.
explanation.he: כתוב: in bed with a cold. ב-bed יש e קצרה.

explanation.en: Most words in the message follow the rules: short vowels (bed, get, milk, shop, bus, stop) and silent e (home, five, Kate). Two words break the silent-e rule: come and some have /ʌ/, like cup.
explanation.he: רוב המילים בהודעה עובדות לפי הכללים: תנועה קצרה (כמו ב-bed וב-shop) ו-e שקטה (כמו ב-home וב-five). רק come ו-some לא עובדות לפי כלל ה-e השקטה: שומעים בהן /ʌ/, כמו ב-cup.

ex.passage:
Name: Sara Mizrahi
Age: 34
Phone: 07700 900 286
Locker: number 13
Yoga class: Room 30, 19:00

questions.statement: Sara is thirty-four.

explanation.en: Age: 34 = thirty-four. Careful: 43 is forty-three.
explanation.he: הגיל הוא 34 = thirty-four. שימו לב: 43 זה forty-three.

questions.question: What is Sara's locker number?

0.en: 30 is the room for the yoga class.
0.he: 30 הוא מספר החדר של שיעור היוגה.

1.en: Look again: the locker is number 13.
1.he: הסתכלו שוב: הלוקר הוא מספר 13.

explanation.en: Locker: number 13 (thirteen).
explanation.he: לוקר מספר 13 ‏(thirteen).

questions.text: The yoga class is in Room ___.

explanation.en: Yoga class: Room 30 (thirty).
explanation.he: שיעור היוגה בחדר 30 ‏(thirty).

questions.statement: Sara's phone number is 07700 900 268.

explanation.en: The form says 07700 900 286: the end is two-eight-six, not two-six-eight. Read phone numbers one number at a time.
explanation.he: בטופס כתוב 07700 900 286: הסוף הוא two-eight-six, לא two-six-eight. קוראים מספר טלפון ספרה אחרי ספרה.

explanation.en: Forms use short lines: Age, Phone, Locker. Read the numbers carefully: 34 is not 43, and 13 is not 30.
explanation.he: בטפסים יש שורות קצרות: Age, Phone, Locker. קראו את המספרים בעיון: 34 זה לא 43, ו-13 זה לא 30.

ex.title: Lior and Yael
ex.passage:
Lior: Hi Yael! Are you at home?
Yael: No, I'm not. I'm at work.
Lior: Is Daniel with you?
Yael: Yes, he is. He isn't happy today. He's very tired!
Lior: Oh no! Are you free at 8? Pizza at my place?
Yael: Yes! Daniel and I are hungry. See you at 8!

questions.statement: Yael is at home.

explanation.en: Yael writes: No, I'm not. I'm at work.
explanation.he: יעל כותבת שהיא לא בבית אלא בעבודה: I'm at work.

questions.statement: Daniel is with Yael.

explanation.en: Lior asks: Is Daniel with you? Yael answers: Yes, he is.
explanation.he: ליאור שואל אם דניאל עם יעל, והיא עונה שכן: Yes, he is.

questions.question: How is Daniel today?
options: Very tired.
Happy.
Sick.

1.en: Yael writes: He isn't happy today.
1.he: יעל כותבת: He isn't happy today – הוא לא שמח היום.

2.en: The messages don't say he's sick. He's tired.
2.he: בהודעות לא כתוב שהוא חולה. הוא עייף.

explanation.en: Yael writes: He's very tired!
explanation.he: יעל כותבת: He's very tired – הוא עייף מאוד.

questions.statement: Yael is busy at 8.

explanation.en: Lior asks: Are you free at 8? Yael answers: Yes! So she isn't busy.
explanation.he: ליאור שואל אם היא פנויה ב-8, והיא עונה Yes! כלומר היא לא עסוקה.

explanation.en: Short answers like No, I'm not and Yes, he is carry the key information.
explanation.he: התשובות הקצרות (No, I'm not / Yes, he is) הן שנותנות את המידע החשוב.

ex.title: Lost: a blue bag

Hi everyone! My bag is lost. It's a blue bag with a small white star on it.

Is it in your classroom? Please send a message to Maya in Room 12. Thank you!

questions.question: What colour is Maya's bag?
options: White.
Blue.
Grey.

0.en: White is the colour of the star on the bag.
0.he: לבן הוא צבע הכוכב שעל התיק.

2.en: Grey is the colour of the laptop.
2.he: אפור הוא צבע המחשב הנייד.

explanation.en: It's a blue bag with a small white star on it.
explanation.he: כתוב: It's a blue bag – תיק כחול.

questions.statement: The laptop is grey.

explanation.en: In the bag: a grey laptop.
explanation.he: כתוב: a grey laptop – מחשב נייד אפור.

questions.statement: The umbrella is green.

explanation.en: The bottle is green. The umbrella is orange.

questions.text: Maya's wallet is ___.

feedback.en: Blue is the bag. Find the word wallet in the list.
feedback.he: כחול הוא התיק. חפשו את המילה wallet ברשימה.

explanation.en: ...and my black wallet.
explanation.he: כתוב: my black wallet – הארנק השחור שלי.

explanation.en: In a list, each thing comes with a/an + colour + noun: a grey laptop, an orange umbrella.
explanation.he: ברשימה כל חפץ בא עם a/an + צבע + שם עצם: a grey laptop, an orange umbrella.

ex.title: Party!
ex.passage:
Hi Noa!
My birthday is on Thursday, the 12th of June. The party is on Friday, the 13th, at my place. It's at half past eight in the evening.
Amir and Sara aren't free. They're in Eilat this weekend.
Are you free? See you on Friday!
Kenji

questions.question: When is Kenji's birthday?
options: Friday, 13th June
Thursday, 12th June
Thursday, 13th June

0.en: Friday the 13th is the party, not the birthday.
0.he: יום שישי ה-13 הוא יום המסיבה, לא יום ההולדת.

2.en: Thursday is right, but the date is the 12th.
2.he: יום חמישי נכון, אבל התאריך הוא ה-12.

explanation.en: My birthday is on Thursday, the 12th of June.
explanation.he: בהודעה כתוב שיום ההולדת ביום חמישי, ה-12 ביוני. המסיבה היא ביום שישי.

questions.question: What time is the party?

1.en: Not a full hour: half past eight = 8:30.
1.he: לא שעה עגולה: half past eight = 8:30.

2.en: 7:30 is half past seven. The message says half past eight.
2.he: 7:30 זה half past seven. בהודעה כתוב half past eight.

explanation.en: It's at half past eight = 8:30.
explanation.he: half past eight = שמונה וחצי.

questions.statement: The party is on Thursday.

explanation.en: The birthday is on Thursday, but the party is on Friday.
explanation.he: יום ההולדת ביום חמישי, אבל המסיבה ביום שישי.

questions.statement: Amir and Sara are free on Friday.

explanation.en: Kenji writes: Amir and Sara aren't free. They're in Eilat this weekend.
explanation.he: קנג'י כותב: Amir and Sara aren't free – הם באילת בסוף השבוע.

explanation.en: Days and dates come after on (on Friday, on the 12th); times come after at (at half past eight).
explanation.he: ימים ותאריכים באים אחרי on (on Friday), ושעות אחרי at (at half past eight).

questions.statement: Daniel is 19.

questions.question: Where is Daniel's home?
options: In Tel Aviv.
In Holon.
In Haifa.

0.en: His college is in Tel Aviv, but his home is in Holon.
0.he: המכללה שלו בתל אביב, אבל הבית שלו בחולון.

2.en: Daniel doesn't write Haifa. He writes: I live in Holon.

ex.title: Our week in the flat
ex.passage: Hi! I'm Maya. I'm 20, and I live in a small flat in Be'er Sheva with two friends, Priya and Lior. We all study at the university. I study biology, and they study computer science. From Sunday to Thursday, we get up early and go to classes. In the evening, we cook dinner together. On Fridays, Priya and Lior go home to their families, and I work in a bookshop. On Saturdays, we sleep late!

questions.statement: Maya and Priya study the same subject.

explanation.en: No. Maya: I study biology, and they (Priya and Lior) study computer science.
explanation.he: לא נכון. מאיה כותבת: I study biology, and they study computer science – היא לומדת ביולוגיה, ופְּרִיָּה וליאור לומדים מדעי המחשב.

questions.statement: The three friends cook dinner together.

explanation.en: In the evening, we cook dinner together.
explanation.he: כתוב: In the evening, we cook dinner together.

questions.question: Who works on Fridays?
options: Priya.
Lior.
Maya.
Priya and Lior.

0.en: On Fridays, Priya goes home to her family.
0.he: בימי שישי פְּרִיָּה נוסעת הביתה למשפחה.

1.en: On Fridays, Lior goes home to his family.
1.he: בימי שישי ליאור נוסע הביתה למשפחה.

3.en: Priya and Lior go home on Fridays. Maya writes: I work in a bookshop.
3.he: פְּרִיָּה וליאור נוסעים הביתה בשישי. מאיה כותבת: I work in a bookshop.

explanation.en: On Fridays, ... I work in a bookshop. I = Maya.
explanation.he: מאיה כותבת שבימי שישי היא עובדת בחנות ספרים (I work in a bookshop).

questions.text: On Saturdays, they sleep ___.

feedback.en: They get up early from Sunday to Thursday. On Saturdays, they sleep late.
feedback.he: הם קמים מוקדם מראשון עד חמישי. בשבת הם ישנים עד מאוחר.

explanation.en: On Saturdays, we sleep late!
explanation.he: כתוב: On Saturdays, we sleep late!

explanation.en: Posts about routines use the present simple a lot, often with we and they.
explanation.he: פוסטים על שגרה משתמשים הרבה בהווה פשוט, לעיתים קרובות עם we ו-they.

ex.title: My grandmother Rina
ex.passage: My grandmother Rina is 74, and she is very busy! She lives in a small house in Rehovot. Every morning, she gets up at six and walks to the park with her dog, Shoko. She teaches English to children three times a week. On Tuesdays, she goes to a pottery class. In the evening, she reads or watches old films on her laptop. Every Friday, the whole family comes to her house for dinner. She cooks, and we wash the dishes!

questions.question: Rina ___ three times a week.
options: goes to a pottery class
teaches English
walks to the park

0.en: The pottery class is on Tuesdays – once a week.
0.he: חוג הקרמיקה הוא בימי שלישי – פעם בשבוע.

2.en: She walks to the park every morning, not three times a week.
2.he: היא הולכת לפארק כל בוקר, לא שלוש פעמים בשבוע.

explanation.en: She teaches English to children three times a week.
explanation.he: כתוב: She teaches English to children three times a week.

questions.statement: Rina gets up early.

explanation.en: She gets up at six.
explanation.he: היא קמה בשש – מוקדם.

questions.statement: Rina washes the dishes on Fridays.

explanation.en: She cooks, and we (the family) wash the dishes.
explanation.he: היא מבשלת, ו-we (המשפחה) שוטפים את הכלים.

questions.text: Shoko is Rina's ___.

explanation.en: ...walks to the park with her dog, Shoko.
explanation.he: כתוב: walks to the park with her dog, Shoko.

explanation.en: Notice all the -s verbs: lives, gets up, walks, teaches, goes, reads, watches, comes, cooks.
explanation.he: שימו לב: כל הפעלים בטקסט באים עם s, כי מדובר באדם אחד (למשל lives, teaches, goes).

ex.title: Re: The room in Bat Yam
ex.passage:
Hi Kenji,
Thanks for your message about the room. Here are some answers. The flat is near the beach in Bat Yam. I'm a nurse. I work at night and sleep during the day. I don't smoke, and I don't have a cat or a dog. My friend Sara lives here too. She doesn't work at night – she's a teacher. Now some questions for you: Do you cook? We cook dinner together on Fridays. And do you play an instrument? Sara plays the piano!
Daniel

questions.statement: Daniel works at night.

explanation.en: I'm a nurse. I work at night.
explanation.he: דניאל כותב שהוא אח ושהוא עובד בלילה (I work at night).

questions.statement: Daniel has a dog.

explanation.en: I don't have a cat or a dog.
explanation.he: דניאל כותב: I don't have a cat or a dog – אין לו חיות.

questions.question: Does Sara work at night?
options: Yes, she does.
No, she doesn't.
Yes, she is.

0.en: Daniel writes: She doesn't work at night.
0.he: דניאל כותב: She doesn't work at night.

2.en: A question with does needs an answer with does: Yes, she does / No, she doesn't. And the text says she doesn't.
2.he: על שאלה עם does עונים עם does: Yes, she does / No, she doesn't. ולפי הטקסט התשובה היא לא.

explanation.en: She doesn't work at night – she's a teacher. So: No, she doesn't.
explanation.he: היא לא עובדת בלילה, כי היא מורה. לכן התשובה היא No, she doesn't.

questions.question: Daniel asks Kenji two questions. What are they about?
options: Work and sleep.
Pets and smoking.
Cooking and music.

0.en: Daniel tells Kenji about his own work and sleep. His questions are Do you cook? and Do you play an instrument?
0.he: דניאל מספר על העבודה והשינה שלו, אבל לא שואל עליהן. הוא שואל על בישול ועל נגינה (cook, play).

1.en: Daniel says he doesn't smoke or have pets. Those are facts, not questions.
1.he: דניאל מספר שהוא לא מעשן ושאין לו חיות. אלה עובדות, לא שאלות.

explanation.en: Do you cook? Do you play an instrument? = cooking and music.
explanation.he: דניאל שואל על בישול (cook) ועל נגינה (play an instrument).

explanation.en: Messages about sharing a flat are full of do/don't: they compare habits.
explanation.he: הודעות על שיתוף דירה מלאות ב-do/don't, כי משווים בהן הרגלים.

ex.title: A day in my life
ex.passage: I'm Kenji, and I'm a university student in Haifa. My weekdays are busy. I always wake up at 6:30, but I usually get up at 6:45! I have a shower and get dressed. I never have breakfast at home – I buy coffee at the station. I commute by train. The train is often late, so I sometimes study on the platform. I usually get home at six. In the evening I cook dinner with my flatmate, Amir. I go to bed at eleven, but Amir never goes to bed before one!

questions.statement: Kenji has breakfast at home.

explanation.en: 'I never have breakfast at home – I buy coffee at the station.'
explanation.he: 'I never have breakfast at home' – הוא אף פעם לא אוכל ארוחת בוקר בבית; הוא קונה קפה בתחנה.

questions.text: Kenji ___ gets up at 6:45.

explanation.en: 'I always wake up at 6:30, but I usually get up at 6:45.' He always wakes up at 6:30, but usually gets up later.
explanation.he: בטקסט: הוא תמיד מתעורר (wake up) ב-6:30, אבל בדרך כלל קם (get up) רק ב-6:45.

questions.question: Why does Kenji sometimes study on the platform?
options: Because his train is often late.
Because he never has breakfast.
Because his flatmate is noisy.

1.en: He never has breakfast at home, but that is not the reason. Look at the word so.

ex.title: The day I almost missed my flight
ex.passage: Last April I had the most stressful morning of my life. My flight to Rome was at 7 a.m., so I wanted to get up at 3:30. Unfortunately, I forgot to set my alarm! When I woke up, it was already 4:45. First, I jumped out of bed and called a taxi. Then I put on my clothes and ran downstairs. On the way to the airport, there was a lot of traffic, and I was sure I was going to miss my flight. After that, things got better. The queue at security was short, and the flight was twenty minutes late. In the end, I was the last person on the plane! Now I always check my alarm twice.

questions.question: Which sentence is the topic sentence?
options: Last April I had the most stressful morning of my life.
First, I jumped out of bed and called a taxi.
Now I always check my alarm twice.

1.en: This is the first event in the middle of the story, not the topic sentence.
1.he: זה האירוע הראשון באמצע הסיפור, לא משפט הנושא.

2.en: This is the last sentence: it ends the story.
2.he: זה המשפט האחרון: הוא מסיים את הסיפור.

explanation.en: The topic sentence comes first and tells us what the story is about: a very stressful morning.
explanation.he: משפט הנושא בא ראשון ואומר על מה הסיפור: בוקר מלחיץ מאוד.

questions.statement: Noa woke up late because she forgot to set her alarm.

explanation.en: 'Unfortunately, I forgot to set my alarm! When I woke up, it was already 4:45.'
explanation.he: בפוסט כתוב שהיא שכחה לכוון שעון מעורר, וכשהתעוררה השעה כבר הייתה 4:45 (When I woke up).

questions.question: Which of these did Noa do first?
options: She ran downstairs.
She called a taxi.
She got dressed.

0.en: She ran downstairs after she got dressed: 'Then I put on my clothes and ran downstairs.'
0.he: היא רצה למטה אחרי שהתלבשה: Then I put on my clothes and ran downstairs.

2.en: She got dressed after she called the taxi. Look for First and Then.
2.he: היא התלבשה אחרי שהזמינה מונית. חפשו את First ואת Then.

explanation.en: 'First, I jumped out of bed and called a taxi. Then I put on my clothes...' First and Then show the order.
explanation.he: בפוסט המילים First ו-Then מראות את הסדר: קודם הזמינה מונית, ואחר כך התלבשה.

explanation.en: 'The queue at security was short.'
explanation.he: בפוסט: The queue at security was short – התור בבידוק היה קצר.

questions.statement: Lior ate insects in Thailand.

ex.title: Finally, some news from Berlin!
ex.passage:
Hi Noa,

Sorry I haven't written for ages. Life here has been crazy! I've lived in Berlin since September, and I still can't believe it. When I arrived, I didn't know a single person and my German was terrible. I cried on the phone to Mum almost every night that first week.

Things have changed a lot since then. I've found a part-time job in a bookshop near my flat, and I've made some good friends there. Last Saturday they took me to a flea market by the river, and I bought an old camera for ten euros. So far I've taken about three hundred photos with it!

My German has improved too, but I still haven't had a real conversation on the phone. Phone calls are the worst!

The big news: I've just applied for a place at a photography school here. The deadline was yesterday, so I sent everything at 11:58 p.m. I haven't heard from them yet.

Have you decided about university yet? Write soon and tell me everything.

Love,
Maya

questions.statement: Maya still lives in Berlin.

explanation.en: 'I've lived in Berlin since September' – present perfect + since: it started in September and is still true.
explanation.he: present perfect + since: היא עברה לברלין בספטמבר, ועדיין גרה שם.

questions.question: How did Maya feel in her first week?
options: Confident, because her German was good.
Lonely and homesick.
Bored, because she had no work.

0.en: She says her German was terrible when she arrived.
0.he: היא כותבת שהגרמנית שלה הייתה נוראית כשהגיעה.

2.en: She doesn't say she was bored. She cried on the phone to her mum every night.
2.he: היא לא כותבת שהשתעממה. היא בכתה בטלפון לאמא שלה כל ערב.

explanation.en: 'I didn't know a single person ... I cried on the phone to Mum almost every night that first week.'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שהיא לא הכירה אף אחד ובכתה בטלפון לאמא כמעט כל ערב: היא הייתה בודדה והתגעגעה הביתה.

questions.question: Why does Maya write 'I bought an old camera' and not 'I've bought an old camera'?
options: Because she doesn't have the camera any more.
Because it happened a very short time ago.
Because she says when it happened: last Saturday, a finished time.

0.en: She still has it: she has taken 300 photos with it. The reason is the finished time.
0.he: המצלמה עדיין אצלה: היא צילמה איתה 300 תמונות. הסיבה היא הזמן שהסתיים.

1.en: For something that happened a moment ago we use just + present perfect. Here she gives a finished time.
1.he: למשהו שקרה הרגע משתמשים ב-just + present perfect. כאן היא מציינת זמן שהסתיים.

explanation.en: Last Saturday is a finished time, so Maya uses the past simple: they took me ... I bought.
explanation.he: Last Saturday הוא זמן שהסתיים, ולכן מאיה משתמשת בעבר פשוט: they took me ... I bought.

questions.statement: Maya has had a long phone conversation in German.

explanation.en: 'I still haven't had a real conversation on the phone.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: I still haven't had a real conversation on the phone – עד עכשיו עוד לא.

questions.text: So far, Maya has taken about ___ photos with the camera.

explanation.en: 'So far I've taken about three hundred photos with it!'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שעד עכשיו (so far) היא צילמה בה כשלוש מאות תמונות.

questions.statement: The photography school has already replied to Maya.

ex.title: The night the lights went out
ex.passage:
It was a hot evening in August, and our whole building was busy. On the ground floor, Mrs Levi was watching her favourite quiz show with the volume up, as usual. Next door, the twins were arguing about a video game. Upstairs, my sister Yael was studying for her driving theory test, and I was making pasta for the family.

At exactly 9:15, everything went dark. The TV stopped, the fridge went silent and somebody on the third floor screamed. For a few seconds nobody moved. Then people started to open their doors and use their phones as torches.

While we were standing on the stairs, someone suggested a picnic on the roof. Ten minutes later, half the building was sitting up there with candles, cold drinks and my pasta, which was only half cooked. Mrs Levi told stories about the building in the 1980s, and the twins actually stopped arguing.

When the power came back at midnight, nobody wanted to go inside. We were still talking when the sun came up. Yael failed her theory test the next week, but she says it was worth it.

questions.question: What was Daniel doing when the lights went out?
options: watching a quiz show
studying for a test
making pasta
arguing about a game

0.en: That was Mrs Levi, on the ground floor.
0.he: זאת הייתה גברת לוי, בקומת הקרקע.

1.en: That was his sister Yael.
1.he: זאת הייתה אחותו יעל.

3.en: That was the twins next door to Mrs Levi.
3.he: אלה היו התאומים, השכנים של גברת לוי.

explanation.en: '...and I was making pasta for the family.' The writer is Daniel, Yael's brother.
explanation.he: בטקסט: ...and I was making pasta for the family. הכותב הוא דניאל, אחיה של יעל.

questions.statement: Mrs Levi was watching TV when the power went off.

explanation.en: She was watching her quiz show, and at 9:15 'the TV stopped'.
explanation.he: היא צפתה בשעשועון שלה, וב-9:15 the TV stopped.

questions.question: Why is most of the first paragraph in the past continuous?
options: It describes the background: what people were in the middle of doing.
It lists events that happened one after another.
It describes how the story ended.

1.en: These actions were happening at the same time, not one after another. Events in order would be in the past simple.
1.he: הפעולות האלה התרחשו באותו זמן, לא בזו אחר זו. אירועים לפי הסדר היו בעבר פשוט.

2.en: The first paragraph is the beginning of the story. It sets the scene.
2.he: הפסקה הראשונה היא תחילת הסיפור. היא בונה את הרקע.

explanation.en: The past continuous sets the scene. The main event comes in the past simple: everything went dark.
explanation.he: העבר המתמשך בונה את הרקע. האירוע המרכזי מגיע בעבר פשוט: everything went dark.

questions.statement: The twins went on arguing on the roof.

explanation.en: '...and the twins actually stopped arguing.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: ...and the twins actually stopped arguing – התאומים דווקא הפסיקו לריב.

questions.text: The electricity came back at ___.

explanation.en: 'When the power came back at midnight, nobody wanted to go inside.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: When the power came back at midnight – החשמל חזר בחצות.

questions.question: Yael failed her test. Why does she say 'it was worth it'?
options: She thinks the test was too easy.
The night was so special that she doesn't regret it.
She passed it on her second try.

0.en: She failed it, so it wasn't too easy for her.
0.he: היא נכשלה, כך שהמבחן לא היה קל מדי בשבילה.

2.en: The text doesn't say anything about a second try.
2.he: בטקסט אין שום דבר על ניסיון שני.

explanation.en: it was worth it = the good experience was more important than the cost (losing study time and failing).
explanation.he: it was worth it = החוויה הטובה הייתה שווה את המחיר (זמן הלימוד שהפסידה והכישלון).

ex.title: Desert hike this Friday – please read!
ex.passage:
Hi everyone,

We're meeting at the main gate at 6:00 a.m. on Friday. The bus leaves at 6:15 sharp. If you arrive late, it will leave without you, so set two alarms!

The forecast says it will be very hot, even early in the morning. In the desert, if you don't drink enough, you get a headache and feel dizzy very quickly, so bring at least three litres of water. Nobody can join the hike unless they have proper walking shoes – no sandals, please.

The route is about 12 kilometres. If everything goes well, we'll reach the spring by 10:00 and have a long break there. You can swim if the water is deep enough, so pack a towel. If the heat gets too much, we'll take the shorter path back.

Phones don't usually work in the canyon, so don't panic if you can't get a signal. I'll send a message to your parents as soon as we're back on the bus.

If you have any questions, call me before Thursday evening.

See you on Friday!
Lior (group leader)

questions.statement: The bus will wait for people who arrive late.

explanation.en: 'If you arrive late, it will leave without you.'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שאם מגיעים באיחור, האוטובוס ייסע בלעדיכם (it will leave without you).

questions.question: What happens if someone comes in sandals?
options: They can take the shorter path.
They'll have to buy shoes at the gate.
They can't come on the hike.
Lior will call their parents.

0.en: The shorter path is for when the heat gets too much, not for sandals.
0.he: הדרך הקצרה מיועדת למקרה שיהיה חם מדי, לא לסנדלים.

1.en: The email doesn't mention buying shoes.
1.he: במייל אין שום דבר על קניית נעליים.

3.en: Lior will message the parents when the group is back on the bus, not because of sandals.
3.he: ליאור ישלח הודעה להורים כשהקבוצה תחזור לאוטובוס, לא בגלל סנדלים.

explanation.en: 'Nobody can join the hike unless they have proper walking shoes – no sandals.' unless = if ... not.
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שאי אפשר להצטרף בלי נעלי הליכה מתאימות. ‏unless = אם לא.

questions.question: 'In the desert, if you don't drink enough, you get a headache.' Why does Lior use the present simple in both parts?
options: It's a plan for Friday only.
It's a general fact: it always happens in the desert.
It's an imaginary situation.

0.en: A plan for Friday would use will in the result. This is true every time, not only on Friday.
0.he: תוכנית ליום שישי הייתה עם will בתוצאה. זה נכון בכל פעם, לא רק ביום שישי.

2.en: It's real and it really happens. That's why it's a zero conditional.
2.he: זה אמיתי וזה באמת קורה. לכן זה תנאי 0.

explanation.en: Zero conditional (present + present) = a general fact: this always happens when you don't drink enough in the heat.
explanation.he: תנאי 0 (הווה + הווה) = עובדה כללית: זה תמיד קורה כשלא שותים מספיק בחום.

questions.text: If everything goes well, the group will reach the spring by ___.

explanation.en: 'If everything goes well, we'll reach the spring by 10:00.'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שאם הכול ילך כשורה, יגיעו למעיין עד 10:00.

questions.question: What will the group do if it gets too hot?
options: Go back on the shorter path.
Swim in the spring.
Call their parents.

1.en: They can swim if the water is deep enough. That's a different condition.
1.he: אפשר לשחות אם המים עמוקים מספיק. זה תנאי אחר.

2.en: Phones don't usually work in the canyon, and Lior will contact the parents later.
2.he: בקניון הטלפונים בדרך כלל לא עובדים, וליאור ייצור קשר עם ההורים מאוחר יותר.

explanation.en: 'If the heat gets too much, we'll take the shorter path back.'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שאם יהיה חם מדי, יחזרו בשביל הקצר יותר (the shorter path).

questions.statement: Lior will message the parents as soon as the group is back on the bus.

explanation.en: 'I'll send a message to your parents as soon as we're back on the bus.' Notice the present (we're) after as soon as.
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שהמדריך ישלח הודעה להורים ברגע שיחזרו לאוטובוס. שימו לב להווה (we're) אחרי as soon as.

ex.title: Ask Sara: Should I take the job abroad?
ex.passage:
Dear Sara,

I'm 24 and I've just got a job offer in Lisbon for one year. The pay is good, and I've always wanted to live abroad. The problem is my grandmother. She's 85, and I visit her every Friday. If I moved to Portugal, she would be really sad, and I would feel terrible. What would you do?

Daniel, Haifa

Dear Daniel,

First, congratulations! Offers like this don't come every day.

I understand your worry, but imagine the opposite situation. If your grandmother were 24 and had this offer, what would you tell her? I'm sure you'd say 'Go!'

If I were you, I'd talk to her first. You might be surprised: many grandparents are proud when their grandchildren have adventures. Also, Lisbon isn't on the other side of the world. If you called her every Friday instead of visiting, she would still hear your voice, and you could fly home for the holidays.

One more thing: if you said no, would you regret it in ten years? Only you can answer that.

Good luck!
Sara

questions.statement: Daniel has already moved to Lisbon.

explanation.en: He has just got the offer and is still deciding: 'If I moved to Portugal...' is imaginary.
explanation.he: הוא רק קיבל את ההצעה ועדיין מתלבט: If I moved to Portugal... הוא מצב דמיוני.

questions.question: Why is Daniel unsure about the job?
options: The pay isn't good enough.
He doesn't like Lisbon.
He's worried about his grandmother.

0.en: He says 'The pay is good'.
0.he: הוא כותב The pay is good – המשכורת טובה.

1.en: He doesn't say this. He has always wanted to live abroad.
1.he: הוא לא כותב את זה. הוא תמיד רצה לגור בחוץ לארץ.

explanation.en: 'The problem is my grandmother... If I moved to Portugal, she would be really sad.'
explanation.he: בטקסט כתוב שהבעיה היא סבתא: אם היא תעבור לפורטוגל, סבתא תהיה עצובה מאוד (she would be really sad).

questions.question: 'If your grandmother were 24...' Why does Sara use were?
options: It's an imaginary situation: his grandmother is 85, not 24.
Sara is talking about the past.
It's a real plan for the future.

1.en: were here isn't about the past. It's the second conditional for something imaginary.
1.he: were כאן לא מדבר על העבר. זה תנאי 2 למשהו דמיוני.

2.en: His grandmother can't become 24, so it isn't a real plan.
2.he: סבתא שלו לא יכולה להיות בת 24, ולכן זו לא תוכנית אמיתית.

explanation.en: if + were = imaginary. Sara asks Daniel to imagine the opposite situation.
explanation.he: if + were = מצב דמיוני. שרה מבקשת מדניאל לדמיין את המצב ההפוך.

questions.statement: Sara thinks Daniel should talk to his grandmother before he decides.

explanation.en: 'If I were you, I'd talk to her first.' This is her advice: talk to his grandmother before he decides.
explanation.he: בטקסט: If I were you, I'd talk to her first – זו העצה שלה: לדבר עם סבתא לפני שהוא מחליט.

ex.title: Class blog: A morning at the olive press
ex.passage:
Last Saturday our class was invited to the Haddad family's olive press, a small business in the hills of the Galilee. It was started by Samir Haddad's grandfather in 1958, and today it is run by Samir and his daughter, Rana.

Rana showed us how the oil is made. First, the olives are picked, usually in October and November. Most of them are still picked by hand, because the trees are very old and machines can damage them. On the same day, the olives are brought to the press, where the leaves are removed and the fruit is washed. Then the olives are crushed into a thick paste, and the oil is separated from the water. Nothing is wasted: the dry paste that is left is used as fuel in winter.

The oil isn't sold in supermarkets. It is bottled at the press and sold directly to customers, and a lot of it is ordered online.

At the end of the visit, we were given fresh bread and oil to taste. Honestly, it was the best breakfast I've had all year!

– Posted by Maya

ex.title: Blog post: Phones in lessons – ban them?
ex.passage:
Last week our head teacher announced that phones will be banned in lessons from next term. A lot of students are angry about it, but in my view, it's the right decision.

First of all, phones are a huge distraction. Since notifications arrive all the time, it's almost impossible to focus on a maths problem for more than a few minutes. For example, in one history lesson last month, I counted eleven different phone sounds!

Secondly, it seems to me that we listen to each other less when our phones are on the desk. In group work, people often check their messages instead of sharing ideas. Therefore, I believe a ban could actually improve teamwork in class.

Of course, phones can be useful for some things, such as checking a word in an online dictionary. But teachers can lend us a tablet when we really need one.

– Lior, 16

ex.title: E-scooters: a smart solution or a street problem?
ex.passage:
Six months ago, shared electric scooters arrived in our town. You can find one on almost every corner, unlock it with an app and leave it wherever your trip ends. But are they good for the town?

Supporters say the scooters have made life much easier. They are cheap for short trips, and in heavy traffic they are often faster than the bus. Maya, a nursing student, rides one to work every morning. "It takes me eight minutes to get to the hospital, whereas the bus takes twenty-five," she says. The scooters are also electric, so they don't add to air pollution in the town centre.

On the other hand, many residents are unhappy. Although there are clear rules about parking, scooters are often left in the middle of the pavement. Daniel, who is 74, says he has nearly fallen over them twice. And despite the speed limit, some riders go far too fast on busy streets.

So what is the answer? The town council is now weighing up the pros and cons. One idea is to create special parking areas. However, this would cost money, and some people feel the town has more important problems.
